STRATEGY: Parent is a tolerant iterated-PD strategy that cooperates while opponent defections stay within a threshold. The trace simulates known population opponents and probes their retaliation/tolerance. It plans to revise by probing early, exploiting tolerant opponents with periodic defections, and cooperating against retaliatory ones.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "So a strategy that, after confirming opponent is tolerant, defects approximately every 10 rounds, will gain around +18 to +20 against those opponents."
STRATEGY: The parent tolerates defections up to a threshold (n//8 or n//10) and retaliates when exceeded; the trace simulates probing at n=10 and then defecting at ~10% rate against tolerant opponents while cooperating against retaliatory ones; it changes the probe timing from n=3 to n=10 to avoid misclassifying slot 6.

STRATEGY: The parent is a tolerant/retaliatory strategy family; the trace simulates slot-by-slot opponent behaviours and revises the strategy to probe at n=10, then exploit tolerant opponents by defecting on a schedule while playing forgiving TFT against retaliatory ones.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE

STRATEGY: Parent probes at n=10, classifies opponent by whether they retaliate at n=11, then plays generous TFT against retaliatory opponents and defects on a schedule against tolerant ones; simulated against slots 0 and 3 and always-C/always-D; changed by unifying post-probe logic, adding always-D detection, and keeping the n=99 defection.
